Triage: lands in `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`(`TEST_DEBT` 的 `@objectstack/formula` 条目 `note`)⇒ **`domain:devx`**, `pm:queue`, type `Task`, `priority:p3`, `tooling`。

**S 级机械卡** —— 正确性由既有门禁机械判定,改动是**给 `note` 加 `TS2739 x1`**。卡自陈:*"No count moves, no baseline moves."* ⇒ 派发时可按机械档取下限模型,⛔ 但仍须跑 `check:type-check-coverage` 证明 count 与 baseline 未动。

**为什么值得一张卡而不是丢掉**:AGENTS.md 已成文的纪律是「re-measure 抬高 count 时必须同笔重写 `note`」,而一份**加不出自己 count 的 itemisation** 是同一失效模式的缩小版 —— 下一个作者按 16 个已知错误做毕业预算,实际碰到 17 个,**而漏掉的那一个恰好是唯一一处一行 helper 加宽就能修的**(`cel-to-filter.test.ts(173,52)`,局部 `ok()` 把第二参数钉死在模块级 `VARS` 的精确形状上)。

⭐ **立卡人的方法值得记名,分诊采信其读数**:该门自己的 `--re-measure` 在 agent 容器上拒绝运行(55 个 workspace 依赖无已构建的类型入口),立卡人**用该门自己的 `remeasureProject` 复制了工程**(同 `extends`、同绝对化 `exclude`、同重建 `typeRoots`)并直接跑。而且复制件是**经标定的、不是断言的**:它独立复现了冻结的 17,并**另外检出某分支新增的 4 个错误、该分支修回 17 后同样跟随**。⇒ 双向对照齐全,这个 `TS2739 x1` 是读数不是推测。

⚠️ **⛔ 不得顺手扩面**:本卡**只改 `note` 一行**。若 dev 想顺带修那个 `TS2739`(把 `ok()` 的第二参数放宽),那是**另一件事** —— 它会移动 count 和 baseline,而该 ledger 是**受管的 shrink-only 工件**。要做就单独立卡,⛔ 不在本卡里做 rider。立卡人当初不在 PR #13630 里顺手修,正是这个理由,分诊背书。

## Claim + Dispatch — R34

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. Branch: **`claude/issue-13631-formula-test-debt-count`**

The defect: `@objectstack/formula`'s `TEST_DEBT` note itemises **16** errors against its own recorded count of **17**.

### Zone 1 — scope
Reconcile the note with the ledger. ⛔ Do **not** "fix" the discrepancy by editing whichever number is easier — **establish which is right by measurement**, then correct the wrong one.

### Zone 2 — PM assumptions (⚠️ measure them; falsifying one is a valued deliverable)
- **A2.1** — I assume the recorded count (17) is the authority and the itemisation (16) is missing an entry. ⚠️ **It may be the reverse** — the ledger may be stale and the true count 16. **Re-measure the actual errors**; ⛔ do not assume which side is wrong.
- **A2.2** — I assume `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` is what pins the recorded number, so correcting the note alone may red it (or vice versa). Check both directions before choosing which to edit.
- **A2.3** — I assume this is a bookkeeping fix with no behaviour change. If the missing entry turns out to be a real uncounted error, that is a different and more interesting finding — report it.

⭐ A ledger whose itemisation disagrees with its own total is exactly the shape where "just make the numbers match" hides the real defect. **Measure first.**

### ⛔ Boundaries
⛔ `content/docs/releases/`. ⛔ `git stash`. Dedicated worktree. Draft PR; this seat arms after review.

## ACCEPT — PR #13736

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. R34.

### The direction of the fix was the whole card, and it was decided by measurement

Two edits were available — drop a listed code to make the tally read 16, or find the 17th.
⭐ The dev **ran the gate's own `--re-measure`** rather than replicating it: cleared its
documented refusal (a ledgered package with no built type entry point) by building the closure
first exactly as `lint.yml` does, and got the gate's own verdict —
`surplus: none — every entry sits exactly at its measurement` across 29 entries, `@objectstack/formula`
at **exactly 17**. So `errors: 17` is authoritative and the **note** was the short side. ⛔ The
easier edit would have been wrong, and only the measurement says which.

### What I re-derived myself

| Claim | Check | Result |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| new note sums to the recorded count | 6+3+3+2+2+**1** | ✅ 17 |
| old note summed to one less | 6+3+3+2+2 | ✅ 16 over a field of 17 |
| the 17th is at `cel-to-filter.test.ts` (173,52) | line 173 is `ok('id in current_user.org_user_ids', { current_user: { org_user_ids: [] } })` — a **partial** context | ✅ the exact shape `ok()` cannot take |
| `filterOf` is a hand-widened copy of `ok` in the same file | line 239, docblock: *"`ok` above pins its second argument to the exact shape of the module-level `VARS`, so it cannot take these partial contexts"* | ✅ verbatim |
| COMPOSITION reads tier itemisations only | the ledger's notes carry `code-tier N / config-tier N / noise N`; this entry's note is a pure per-code tally with no tier word | ✅ produces no itemisation |

Corroborated without running `tsc` — the position, the cause and the already-widened sibling
helper all read straight off `origin/main`.

### Zone 2 outcome — A2.2 falsified, and the falsification is the more useful half

- **A2.2 FALSIFIED.** The gate pins the **count**; ⛔ **nothing mechanical reads this note.**
  #10722's COMPOSITION check exists for exactly this shape but, by an explicitly reasoned
  decision in its own docblock, never sums per-code tallies — they are *"partial by
  construction"*. So `tierItemisation()` returns `null` for this entry and it is **unguarded**.
  ⭐ Measured on both the old and the new note **with a positive control that fired**
  (`code-tier 30, config-tier 25, noise 34.` → sum 89 vs `errors: 80` → 1 problem), so the empty
  reading is a measurement, not a dead probe. **That is why a 16-over-17 note survived on `main`
  at all** — the card's own root cause, found by disproving my assumption rather than by
  implementing it.
- **A2.1 HELD**, **A2.3 HELD with a refinement**: the TS2739 is a real code-tier error but ⛔ **not
  an uncounted one** — it sat inside the frozen 17 from the start and was merely unlisted. The
  "more interesting finding" branch did not materialise; this is bookkeeping, zero behaviour
  change, no baseline movement.

⭐ Correct mitigation for an unguarded entry: the note now **says it is unguarded**, so the next
reader does not mistake the entry's silence for a check.

### Gates

16 named gates at exit 0 at the merged head `a8a9374b6`, family re-derived post-merge and
identical. ⭐ **Both convention-triggered obligations for editing a gate script were run, not just
the path-derived family.** `pnpm lint` repo-wide (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) exit 0 in 108s —
⛔ **not narrowed, so no narrowing declaration is owed**, which is the right way to retire that
paragraph. `check-test-completeness.mjs` exit 3 = its own documented `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`
branch, recorded **NOT MEASURED**, ⛔ not red. No ablation run, correctly: nothing executable
changed, so there is no behaviour to ablate. `skip-changeset` is right — `scripts/` publishes
nothing. **0 MCP calls**, the whole run on the container's REST channel — zero GraphQL pool burn.

### The two out-of-scope items — I am upholding both non-filings

- **The TS2739 is retirable** by widening `ok()`'s second parameter, and triage explicitly ruled
  that repair out of this card (it moves count and baseline on a shrink-only ledger). ⛔ **No card**,
  and the reason is better than "it would duplicate the ledger": the note now carries the file, the
  position, the cause and the fact that a widened helper already exists three hundred lines away.
  **A repair instruction that precise, sitting on the entry that tracks the debt, beats a queue card
  nobody has scheduled.** With 33 entries and 1542 raw errors, one card per repairable error is a
  flood, not a plan.
- **The COMPOSITION per-code-tally blind spot** is documented and inventoried in the gate's own
  docblock (21 of 33 entries unguarded) and the trade is deliberately priced there — a partial tally
  must stay writable. ⛔ Nothing here the code does not already say. Recorded, not filed.

### Disposition

⛔ Not governed surface (one `scripts/**` file), no clause ② limb, no `needs:contract-review`.
**Arming now**; `Fixes #13631` closes this card on merge.
